name: game-authoring-integration
goal: Prove native game creation authoring saved checkpoint images and play on current main before squash landing

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Integrate origin/main 1374b7a9 then verify native project creation authoring checkpoint persistence and play before merge. Existing full-check failures remain unproven until reproduced.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: workspace-test-config root fixture lacked generated-project dependency tests under ignored .cache; native authoring scenarios mocked every bridge method and never crossed UI socket service repository lifecycle.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test and shared coverage; run it failing before repair and record the command, assertion and result.
steps.evidence: Recorded failing-test commit 3ef41ae5: real root Vitest collects six files including cached generated-game dependencies instead of its three owned files.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Retain normal root and inherited workspace coverage while excluding .cache and nested node_modules from root discovery.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
